table.name: Documents
table.purpose: One row per document in a document/template system. Each document has a unique ID, a title, an optional single-letter description code, and is associated with a template (Templates) and has many paragraphs (Paragraphs).

Document_Description.name: Document_Description
Document_Description.description: Short description or label of the document. Despite the name, values are single lowercase letters (y, h, w, b, f, r, k, z, n) with no evident pattern, so the actual meaning of these codes is unclear; they may be abbreviations, category codes, or placeholder/test data.

Document_ID.name: Document_ID
Document_ID.description: Unique identifier of the document (primary key). Values are non-contiguous integers (0, 1, 76, 2394, up to ~385 million), suggesting IDs assigned from a larger system or reused sequence. Referenced by Paragraphs.Document_ID, i.e. each document has many paragraphs.

Document_Name.name: Document_Name
Document_Name.description: Human-readable title of the document (e.g. 'A history of Arts', 'Robbin CV', 'How to read a book'). Unique across the 15 rows.

Template_ID.name: Template_ID
Template_ID.description: Foreign key to Templates.Template_ID, indicating which template the document is based on. The lookup table's Template_Details labels are empty, so the meaning of individual template IDs cannot be determined.

table.name: Paragraphs
table.purpose: Stores the text of individual paragraphs extracted from documents, keyed by Paragraph_ID and linked to their parent document via Document_ID. In the observed rows each paragraph's text is a country or territory name, so these documents appear to be lists or references of countries. The Other_Details union column exists for extra typed details but is unused (all null).

Document_ID.name: Document_ID
Document_ID.description: Foreign key to Documents.Document_ID; identifies the document each paragraph belongs to. Many paragraphs can reference the same document.

Paragraph_ID.name: Paragraph_ID
Paragraph_ID.description: Primary key of the Paragraphs table; unique identifier for each paragraph row.

Paragraph_Text.name: Paragraph_Text
Paragraph_Text.description: Text content of the paragraph. In this data every value is a single country or territory name (e.g. Somalia, Japan, Korea), suggesting the paragraphs here are short entries naming countries, though the column itself is generic paragraph text.

table.name: Ref_Template_Types
table.purpose: Lookup/reference table of document template types, one row per type, used to classify templates in the Templates table (which in turn relate to Documents and Paragraphs).

Template_Type_Code.name: Template_Type_Code
Template_Type_Code.description: Short code identifying a document template type (e.g. PPT, CV, AD, BK, PP). Primary key of this lookup table; referenced by Templates.Template_Type_Code.

Template_Type_Description.name: Template_Type_Description
Template_Type_Description.description: Human-readable label for the template type code (Presentation, CV, Advertisement, Book, Paper).

table.name: Templates
table.purpose: Catalog of document templates, each with a type (book, paper, presentation, CV, advertisement), a version number, and an effective date range. Documents reference a template via Template_ID. The date values look randomly generated (From frequently after To), suggesting synthetic data.

Date_Effective_From.name: Date_Effective_From
Date_Effective_From.description: Start of the template's validity period, stored as a date/time string. Note: values appear to be synthetic/random (From often later than To), so the temporal semantics are not reliable.

Date_Effective_To.name: Date_Effective_To
Date_Effective_To.description: End of the template's validity period, stored as a date/time string. In many rows it precedes Date_Effective_From, so the data appears synthetic and the interval meaning is questionable.

Template_ID.name: Template_ID
Template_ID.description: Primary key identifying each template row; referenced by Documents.Template_ID.

Template_Type_Code.name: Template_Type_Code
Template_Type_Code.description: Code classifying the template's type; foreign key to Ref_Template_Types (PPT=Presentation, CV=CV, AD=Advertisement, PP=Paper, BK=Book).

Version_Number.name: Version_Number
Version_Number.description: Version of the template, an integer 0–9; multiple templates share the same version number, so it identifies a revision of a template rather than being unique.
